denominator_note: accuracy() is mean(margins > 0). A zero-norm row has margin exactly 0 for any theta, so it is always counted incorrect. Unfiltered accuracy is c/90 and nonzero-only accuracy is c/82 for the same count c of correct predictions, so the gap is c*8/(82*90). It scales with c and is NOT a constant offset.
max_gap_note: 100*(1 - 82/90) = 8.89 pp is the MAXIMUM gap, reached only if all 82 nonzero rows are correct. It is the ceiling gap, not the depression applied to any reported accuracy.
superseded_wording: 'the 8 zero-norm holdout rows depress every reported accuracy by roughly 8.9 points'. Incorrect: that conflates the ceiling gap with the actual per-model gap.
